titulo: Ukraine-Russia talks end with deal on prisoner swap, but Moscow remains cool on European involvement – Europe live
cuerpo: Talks break up after a short time on second day in Abu Dhabi but Russian negotiator says more will be held Separately, I am also keeping an eye on Italy, with reports that several schools are being evacuated after receiving bomb threats by emails. According to Rai and Sky TG24 , the email was signed by “Mikhail Andropov” – the same name used in several hoax bomb alarms against European flights last week. Continue reading...
